scenario.label_zh: 根据海边天气调整骑行
scenario.goal_zh: 结合眼前天气和遮雨条件选择较短的骑行路线

context_zh: 两位朋友在海边租车点决定当天骑多远。
author: author-phase02-b

sentences.speaker: Keira
sentences.text: Shall we ride all the way to the lighthouse?

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Look at those clouds over the sea. I think we should stay closer to town.

sentences.speaker: Keira
sentences.text: The forecast said the rain would arrive this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: It may come earlier. There is nowhere to shelter on the last stretch.

sentences.speaker: Keira
sentences.text: Let's turn back at the harbour, then. We can stop at the café if it starts.

sentences.speaker: Luis
sentences.text: Agreed. The lighthouse can wait for a clearer day.
